'''"Sophistication"''' was an art gallery located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. It was operated by [[Tal Anavere]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]], who used her art business as a means to build relationships with high-ranking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bureaucrats. The information she gleaned from such encounters she passed on to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CRO" />
